route: /style-board/ (the style board: module proof:band, longest and shortest copy, photos as grey frames)

findings.issue: At 390px the three-column fabric table is still squeezed inside the padded tinted panel, so most cells wrap to one or two words a line ('Standard / spandex / blends', 'LYCRA Xtra / Life, / Carvico, / ECONYL, / REPREVE', 'Relative / price'). Rows run three to five lines high, and the table is taller than the section's copy above it. This repeats the earlier finding: the shot shows the fix was not made.
findings.reference: The competitor's intro/proof modules run plain text across the full content width on phones, with no inset panel taking width from it.
findings.fix: In reference.css, under 600px, cut the inline padding of the m9-charts tinted panel (the section-charts table wrapper) to about 0.75rem. Set `.prose__table :is(th, td)` (the charts table cells) to an inline padding of about 0.5rem so the three columns get that width back.

findings.issue: The section heading 'What Drives Your Fabric Cost' is set in DM Sans 700, a heavy bold. The competitor's matching intro/proof heading ('Your Collection, Kept On Track') is a light, regular-weight display line, so ours reads much darker than the module it follows.
findings.reference: The competitor sets its intro/proof H2 large and light (regular or book weight), with weight used only on short bold phrases inside the body text.
findings.fix: In reference.css, set `.block--proof h2` to a lighter weight (400–500, DM Sans 500 is loaded). Leave the size alone, since the template fits it to the words.

findings.issue: The same lighter-weight treatment applies to the proof band's heading wherever one is present. With no heading, the shortest sample is a lone 34-word paragraph sitting straight under the beige table panel, and the gap above it is wider than the gap between m9's paragraphs and its table. It reads as a stray line rather than a section.
findings.reference: The competitor's proof blocks without a heading sit as a short text block with the same even section gap above and below.
findings.fix: In reference.css, make the top padding of a `.block--proof` that has no h2 match the section rhythm used between m9 and m9-charts, so the gaps are equal.
